segments.sn46.76:1.1: “Nirodhasaññā, bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā.
segments.sn46.76:1.2: Kathaṃ bhāvitā ca, bhikkhave, nirodhasaññā kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā?
segments.sn46.76:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu nirodhasaññāsahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti … pe …
segments.sn46.76:1.4: nirodhasaññāsahagataṃ upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
segments.sn46.76:1.5: Evaṃ bhāvitā kho, bhikkhave, nirodhasaññā evaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsāti.
segments.sn46.76:2.1: “Nirodhasaññāya, bhikkhave, bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ –
segments.sn46.76:2.2: diṭṭheva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā.
segments.sn46.76:2.3: Kathaṃ bhāvitāya, bhikkhave, nirodhasaññāya kathaṃ bahulīkatāya dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ –
segments.sn46.76:2.4: diṭṭheva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā?
segments.sn46.76:2.5: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu nirodhasaññāsahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti … pe …
segments.sn46.76:2.6: nirodhasaññāsahagataṃ upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
segments.sn46.76:2.7: Evaṃ bhāvitāya kho, bhikkhave, nirodhasaññāya evaṃ bahulīkatāya dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ –
segments.sn46.76:2.8: diṭṭheva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā”ti.
segments.sn46.76:3.1: “Nirodhasaññā, bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahato atthāya saṃvattati, mahato yogakkhemāya saṃvattati, mahato saṃvegāya saṃvattati, mahato phāsuvihārāya saṃvattati.
segments.sn46.76:3.2: Kathaṃ bhāvitā ca, bhikkhave, nirodhasaññā kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahato atthāya saṃvattati, mahato yogakkhemāya saṃvattati, mahato saṃvegāya saṃvattati, mahato phāsuvihārāya saṃvattati?
segments.sn46.76:3.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu nirodhasaññāsahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti … pe …
segments.sn46.76:3.4: nirodhasaññāsahagataṃ upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
segments.sn46.76:3.5: Evaṃ bhāvitā kho, bhikkhave, nirodhasaññā evaṃ bahulīkatā mahato atthāya saṃvattati, mahato yogakkhemāya saṃvattati, mahato saṃvegāya saṃvattati, mahato phāsuvihārāya saṃvattatī”ti.

lines: Maraṇasaññāti “avassaṃ maritabbaṃ, maraṇapaṭibaddhaṃ me jīvitan”ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhantassa uppannasaññā.
Tesaṃ navasu appanā honti, ekādasa upacārajjhānikā.
Tattha sā maggasahagatā lokuttarā, yā pana nibbāne ninnabhāvena pavattā, upasamānussatisahagatā ca, sā lokiyāti āha –
“Ekādasasu appanā hoti, nava upacārajjhānikā”ti pāṭho gahetabbo.
Vīsati kammaṭṭhānānīti idampi idhāgatanayo, na visuddhimaggādīsu āgatanayo.
Ettha ca ārammaṇādīsu yathāyogaṃ appanaṃ upacāraṃ vā pāpuṇitvā arahattappattassa pubbabhāgabhūtā vipassanāmaggabojjhaṅgā kathitā.
